notes: The postposed article ten (s014) is rule 31's article-follows-noun case with a prepositional modifier: 'a dispensation' stays on the anarthrous noun oikonomian, the article keeps only the bare relativizer 'which', and the supplied copula goes to en with 'is in'.
s002 prosechein heads on 'heed' under rules 17 and 91, 'give' being the empty support verb; the infinitival 'to' is a rule 61 helper on the same verb.

The verse-final italicized 'so do I now' is added under rule 5. Rule 37 was ruled out by name: the kathos of 1TI.1.3 is already spent on 'As' there and, under rule 82, never takes the correlative 'so', so no token in this verse or in a neighbouring one licenses the supplied apodosis.
